description: Create a direct payment with a fully-specified payment_method. Use when you already have a payment_method id/token or when you want server-to-server flow without the hosted page. For voucher/cash methods the response contains redirect/display data.

capture.description: Card only: false for auth-only, true (default) for auth+capture

ewallet.description: Rapyd ewallet id (ewallet_xxx) to credit on successful capture

payment_method.description: Payment method object. Either { type: 'xxx_method_name', fields: {...} } for one-shot use, or { type: 'card', id: 'pmt_xxx' } for a saved method.

name: create_payment
